meta.name: qodo-pr-resolver
meta.description: Review and resolve PR issues with Qodo - get AI-powered code review issues and fix them interactively (GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Azure DevOps)

copy.tagline: 审查并交互式修复代码审查问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要审查PR并修复代码问题
copy.tagline_en: Review and fix code review issues interactively
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often review PRs and fix code issues

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能获取当前分支的 Qodo 代码审查问题，展示并逐一或批量修复，还会回复每条内联评论。
howto.when: 当你问及代码审查、想查看 Qodo 问题或修复 Qodo 评论时触发。匹配“pr resolver”等关键词。

say.text: 帮我看看这个 PR 的 Qodo 问题。
say.note: 获取并显示所有 Qodo 审查问题列表。

say.text: 自动修复所有 Qodo 高优先级的 bug。
say.note: 自动应用标记为“Fix”的严重和高优先级问题。

howto.what_en: Claude can fetch Qodo review issues for the current branch's open PR, display them, and help fix them interactively or in batch, replying to each inline comment.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for a code review, to see Qodo issues, or to fix Qodo comments. Also matches keywords like 'pr resolver'.

say_en.text: Show me the Qodo issues for this PR.
say_en.note: Fetches and displays all Qodo review issues.
Automatically applies fixes for critical and high issues.
